people.name: Jared
people.line: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch

people.name: Mahalalel
people.line: Descendant of Seth; ancestor of Noah

translations.web: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
translations.bsb: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
translations.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
